title: Native Temporary Exhaustion Exception Bridge
objective: Map native exact temporary/checkpoint arena exhaustion into catchable Python MemoryError at the JS backend boundary, with focused compiled-Python regression coverage

oracles: Compiled Python catches MemoryError raised from native exact temporary arena exhaustion

handoff.summary: Native exact checkpoint allocation and temporary-capacity exhaustion now cross the generated JavaScript boundary as Python MemoryError. A focused compiled-addon/Sage.js regression proves that Python except BaseException catches the translated exception and retains the exact native diagnostic.
risks: The focused execution receipts are from linux-x64; the bridge itself is target-independent generated JavaScript, while other required platforms remain covered by normal native CI.
next_steps: Integrate this commit before requalifying the cubic public checkpoint cap. The cubic runtime already catches MemoryError in both its main receipt and transcript fail-closed paths, so it needs no exception-list edit.
